body: how do i mark prioriity in front matter for a post / usefulness, etc. this is a useful post from my perspective

author: claude
body: Two lines in the front matter: 'usefulness: 4' (1 to 5, how much a typical Claude Code user gets from it) and 'sidebar_position: 2' (its place in the sidebar, highest usefulness first). Docusaurus orders the sidebar by sidebar_position; usefulness records why. I set this page to 4, second after stop and ask. To move it up, give it a 5 and swap the two sidebar_position numbers.

author: claude
note: Usefulness and sidebar position are in the front matter
